body.objective: Turn the finite coherent hard--collinear projector witness REVERSE_PHYSICS_BT_COLLINEAR_PROJECTOR_TRANSPORT_V1 into a dynamical Bateman--Turok asymptotic-state construction, or find the first exact obstruction. Derive the first-order splitting generator from the broken-vacuum BT/PS Hamiltonian, place outgoing and incoming degenerate channels on one regulated continuum carrier, and test whether its Gram operator reproduces the certified 1/512 per unordered final pair without violating the one-sided charge radical.
depends_on: S. Bateman and N. Turok, arXiv:2607.00096v1, with its tree-level and collinear-asymptotic-state claim boundaries
activates: a continuum coherent/dressed projector with a dynamically derived normalization rather than a fitted Gram coefficient
a common incoming-plus-outgoing degenerate-state real--virtual cancellation test
only after that cancellation, the first complete renormalized NLO quotient trace and beyond-tree positivity test
body.current_gate: ASYMPTOTIC_GENERATOR_GRAM (fail-closed): derive K_BT from the broken-vacuum cubic interaction and prove, on a declared regulated splitting carrier, that K_BT^sharp K_BT has coefficient 1/512 per unordered final pair in the normalization used by the certified real response. The finite four-channel rotation is an existence witness, not evidence that this equality holds dynamically.
body.stop_condition: EITHER construct the regulated BT asymptotic generator with incoming and outgoing degenerate sectors, prove its neutral charge, reproduce the exact Gram coefficient, and independently verify cancellation and radical closure on the declared carrier; OR exhibit the first exact mismatch in coefficient, charge, domain, continuum existence, or normalization. Land a strict certificate/schema, method-distinct verifier, decisive mutation, receipt, report, assumptions, missing-object ledger, and next-gate decision.
body.forbid: no promotion of the finite projector witness to a BT dressed-state or KLN theorem; no fitting the generator norm to 1/512 and calling that a dynamical derivation; no final-state-only cancellation promoted over unresolved incoming collinear sectors; no global Hilbert metric imported into the Krein theory; no reduced scalar result promoted to tensor gravity, BRST cohomology, a Lorentzian BV propagator, Hadamard state, causal perturbative AQFT, quantum master equation, or all-orders unitarity; no floating-point canonical forms, ranks, cocycle tests, or trivialization certificates
body.resource_hint: Proof-first contract. Candidate theorem: the charge-neutral asymptotic transport generated by the leading BT/PS collinear splitting has a regulated three-channel Gram operator equal to the certified real-emission response, so projector idempotence supplies the unique compensating hard normalization. Carrier: one hard state, the full final-pair splitting-fraction continuum, and the first incoming degenerate sectors at order lambda^2 relative to the hard process; no tensor lift. Proof obligations: derive K_BT from the Hamiltonian, fix domains and resolution flow, prove pseudo-unitarity and charge neutrality, compute K_BT^sharp K_BT exactly or with certified analytic bounds, match all phase-space and identical-particle factors, and show regulator cancellation in the quotient trace. Counterexample strategy: reverse the delta-prime sign, omit an incoming channel, vary the resolution slicing, mutate a positive charge shift, and compare the dynamical Gram coefficient against 1/512. Finite machine boundary: exact rational/algebraic coefficients and certified one-dimensional integrals under a 500000 KB memory cap; unresolved all-orders resummation remains a missing object rather than a pass.
